biome: Coastal grassland, open scrub and woodland
facts: A long neck lets an Aldabra giant tortoise reach grass at its feet and foliage above it.
The high domed shell and thick, column-shaped legs support a body that can weigh over 200 kilograms.
These tortoises graze in open grassland and spend the hottest part of the day in shade.
Females bury their eggs. Young tortoises feed for themselves after hatching.
sources: Turtle Taxonomy Working Group, Turtles of the World, 10th edition (2025): https://iucn-tftsg.org/wp-content/uploads/crm.10.checklist.atlas_.v10.2025.pdf
Habitat thresholds, care rates, movement speeds and price are simulation parameters. The incubation period uses the game's gestation timer.
